snippet.title: Nientum - Op.ZERO | Release Date Trailer (Steam, Oct 14, 2026)
snippet.description:
Nientum - Op.ZERO launches in full on Steam, October 14, 2026.
▶ Steam (wishlist now): https://store.steampowered.com/app/2725250/Nientum__OpZERO/

The curtain fell long ago on a forgotten theater. The lights, the music, the applause — all of it sleeps in the dark. Backstage, two girls wake without their memories — Aleph takes the director's chair, Liora takes the stage. Only her voice can raise the curtain again. Nientum - Op.ZERO is a 2D rhythm-action adventure where every level is a performance. Dash through the backstage, step into the spotlight, and play the story itself — rhythm becomes your script, and boss fights become duets you win by keeping time. Each restored stage rekindles the theater, and your choices decide how the final curtain falls. Fully voiced by an all-star Japanese cast. 98% Very Positive on Steam in Early Access — the full theater opens October 14, 2026.

Aleph — CV: Chika Anzai / Liora — CV: Yuki Takada / Mordred — CV: Takehito Koyasu

Official site: https://queseragames.net
Official X: https://x.com/nientum
